docs: a reduced-motion reader sees a drawn frame for a live example that never settles (rich-docs-examples-xuu.tig)

The still frame is the screen when the body settles or a second after the
program first draws, whichever is sooner, so a loop, a prompt, and a
fullscreen run that ends back on the main screen each show a frame.

docs: Powerline and capsule glyphs draw as shapes in example output (rich-docs-examples-xuu.b35) (#182)

* docs: Powerline and capsule glyphs draw as shapes in example output (rich-docs-examples-xuu.b35)

The docs load a 40-glyph Powerline subset of Nerd Fonts Symbols, first in the
code font stack behind a unicode-range, fitted to Menlo's cell so a cap covers
its segment's background. scripts/powerline-font.py builds it.

* docs: font carries the powerline project's notice too; generator pinned to its source and reads every outline before fitting any (rich-docs-examples-xuu.b35)
